summary: The HSPnetDropDownList is a customized DropDownList control used in web applications to manage the display and behavior of dropdown lists with integrated features like CSS styling based on selection.
purpose: To provide a dropdown list control that supports special functionalities like displaying an 'ALL' option, highlighting selected items, and changing styles based on selection.

workflows.name: Highlight Selected Option
steps: Check if the selected index is greater than 0
If true, apply red color style to the dropdown

workflows.name: Insert ALL Option
steps: Check if the ALL property is true
Insert 'ALL' option with a value of '0' at the top of the list

business_rules: The first item in the dropdown is always the 'ALL' option
The select element is highlighted red if an option other than 'ALL' is selected
system_behavior: On PreRender: Adjusts the style of the dropdown based on the selected item
On DataBound: Inserts an 'ALL' option if the ALL property is true
